units.source_text: “要是发生那种事，明天也许就不想再见到你了。

en.t: If that sort of thing happened, by tomorrow I might not want to see you anymore.

units.source_text: 也不会有兴致跟你聊天了。

en.t: I probably would not feel like talking with you either.

units.source_text: 我从山上来到这个村子，难得见人就感到亲热。

en.t: I came down from the mountains to this village, and it is rare enough to meet people that I feel warmly toward them.

units.source_text: 我不向你求欢，要知道我是个游客啊。”

en.t: I am not trying to seduce you; you have to remember that I am only a traveler.
